messages:
samir: heads-up — EU1 GPU request queue spiked ~11:04 UTC, Incident-bot sent ~28 pages in 12m. Nodes flapping + 503s from proxy.
incident-bot: [ALERT] eu1-gpu-pool queue_depth=72 burst=18 error_rate=0.12 — paging oncall (samir).
marta: seen similar noise earlier this week, might be prefix cache misses + a bad rollout.
devon: can you paste the failing pod logs?
samir: tail of proxy logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-18T11:03:45Z proxy main warn: upstream 503 for shard-3
2026-03-18T11:04:01Z scheduler info: enqueue request v=chat seq=512 queue_len=68
2026-03-18T11:04:12Z node watcher warn: node-autoscaler scaleDown failed: quota
```
lee: looks like a sustained enqueue, not a single spike. autoscaler couldn't grab more GPU nodes because regional quota was hit.
samir: correct — quota exhausted in eu1; fallback routing didn't trigger fast enough. IncidentBot flooded pages because rule is "page on enqueue>10 within 5m" and it doesn't do burst backoff.
marta: suggestion: add a short suppression window for bursts and a separate escalation policy for sustained queue growth. e.g., suppress if >N pages in M minutes and still escalate after X minutes.
devon: Agree. We should also add a soft-routing to eu2 for best-effort traffic before full failover. That reduces paging load.
ton y: (ops) can we flip a throttle on Incident-bot temporarily? I can patch config if we agree on thresholds.
lee: propose immediate patch: suppress_threshold=10, suppress_window=300s, sustained_threshold=50, sustained_window=600s. That should stop churn pages but keep escalation if problem persists.
samir: ok - let's apply a temporary config change while we sort quota with infra. Steps: 1) set incident-bot suppress_window; 2) enable eu2 best-effort routing; 3) handoff assignment.
ops-bot: running playbook "incidentbot:apply-config" with args {"suppress_threshold":10,"suppress_window":300,"sustained_threshold":50,"sustained_window":600}.
incident-bot: config update accepted. New rules effective immediately.
marta: I'm taking primary oncall for EU1 now — will monitor queue and routing. @devon, please be backup.
devon: on it. I'll keep an eye on eu2 routing metrics and prepare a manual reroute if autoscaler still fails.
lee: created a short runbook note: https://redwood-internal/ops/runbooks/eu1-gpu-queue (added steps: check quota, increase region quota, route-weight tweak, incidentbot revert).
samir: quoting quick commands to revert if needed:
```bash
# patch incident-bot config
rbctl incidentbot set --suppress-window 300 --suppress-threshold 10 --sustained-window 600 --sustained-threshold 50
# flip eu2 best-effort routing
rbctl routing set --region-eu2 --weight 0.12 --scope best-effort
```
marta: after 5m, queue dropped to 22 — incident pages stopped. Still seeing some 503s but less frequent.
devon: metric: eu1_gpu_queue 11:04->11:18 went 72->22. eu2 accepted ~9% of rerouted traffic.
ton y: I've opened a quota request with cloud: ticket #CLOUD-8719, asked for +8 GPUs in eu1. ETA 48h.
lee: temporary capacity workaround: we can also enable spill-to-dedicated for enterprise customers to reduce host load. I'll raise a PR for that.
samir: plan: keep suppress rules for 24h, monitor, if sustained growth hits sustained_threshold we'll auto-escalate to oncall pager again. Marta will lead.
marta: acknowledged. I'll post a short postmortem in #incidents if we don't have a clean rollback in 24h.
incident-bot: [INFO] monitoring window active. Will escalate if sustained queue persists.
ops-bot: note saved to incident tracker: INC-2026-0318-12.
lee: small follow-up — add a test in incidentbot CI for burst suppression so this doesn't regress.
devon: ack. I'll add the test and a toggle in config for canary rollout.
samir: thanks all. I'll update the handoff doc and close this thread when EU1 is stable. :thumbsup:
